registration.statement: Within the registered empirical-package grammar, contributor material can enter official prediction without gaining execution or scientific authority in exactly one form: strict data-only program fields are parsed by the admitted interpreter, the census and model-admitted receipts are identical before and after handling, and every extra field, executable source or protected-tree change halts admission.
registration.title: Hostile empirical-package and authority protection
